# sigma_tenant_deployment_capabilities (Resource)

Authoritatively manages which tenant organizations a Sigma tenant can deploy to. This resource uses a Sigma Beta API and may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_tenant_deployment_capabilities" "example" {
  tenant_id    = "source-tenant-id"
  capabilities = ["target-tenant-id"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `capabilities` (Set of String) Authoritative set of tenant organization IDs this tenant can deploy to.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant organization that receives deployment capabilities.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tenant organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
terraform import sigma_tenant_deployment_capabilities.example source-tenant-id
```
